resolved.title: 并发 Concurrency
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Concurrency[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

[b]Concurrency[/b] means multiple computations are happening at the same time.
It is used when your program has multiple things to do.

Concurrency is about creating multiple processes executing independently.

For example, imagine a shooting game, where many things are happening at the same time: enemies are running and shooting, points are being calculated, weapons are being unlocked, etc.

All of these things need to be happening concurrently.
In order to use concurrency, the program is broken into parts, which are then executed separately.
[note]When using concurrency, we are able to achieve the intended results in less time, thus increasing the overall performance and efficiency of our programs.[/note]

content.text:
**并发**(Concurrency)意味着同时计算多个任务。
当你的程序有多个事情要做时，就会喜欢上并发👏。

并发是指创建多个独立执行的进程。

例如，想象一下射击游戏，许多事情都在同时发生：敌人在跑动和射击，积分在计算，武器在解锁，等等。

所有这些事情都需要并发地发生。
为了使用并发，程序被拆解成若干部分，然后分别执行。
content.text_html:
Concurrency means multiple computations are happening at the same time. It is used when your program has multiple things to do.

Concurrency is about creating multiple processes executing independently.

For example, imagine a shooting game, where many things are happening at the same time: enemies are running and shooting, points are being calculated, weapons are being unlocked, etc.

All of these things need to be happening concurrently. In order to use concurrency, the program is broken into parts, which are then executed separately.

并发意味着多个计算同时发生。 当你的程序有多件事情要做时，就会用到它。

并发是指创建多个独立执行的进程。

例如，想象一下一个射击游戏，许多事情都在同时发生：敌人在跑动和射击，积分在计算，武器在解锁，等等。

所有这些事情都需要并发地发生。 为了使用并发性，程序被分解成若干部分，然后分别执行。

resolved.title: 协程 Goroutine
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Goroutines[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

To achieve concurrency, Go provides [b]Goroutines[/b].

A [b]Goroutine[/b] is much like a thread to accomplish multiple tasks, but it consumes fewer resources than OS threads.

When a program is broken down into separate tasks, each Goroutine can be used to accomplish a task, enabling concurrency in our program.
[note][b]Goroutines[/b] are not OS threads: they are virtual threads; managed by Go. You can have thousands of Goroutines running in a Go program.[/note]

content.text:
为了实现并发性，Go提供了**Goroutine**，也称为**协程**。

一个**Goroutine**很像一个线程来完成多个任务，但比操作系统线程消耗更少的资源。

当一个程序拆解成不同的任务时，每个Goroutine都可以用来完成一个任务，从而实现程序的并发性。
